mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly increase in non-farm payrolls exceeding 100,000 and a decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals robust labor market conditions that enhance consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts level below 450,000 units (HOUST < 450) signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 450 and the regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of retail and food services sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising (month-over-month).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary tightening that coincides with economic deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and services output, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising (month-over-month).
